description: Turn a URL into LLM-ready Markdown with crawl4ai's /md contract: f raw|fit (raw or pruned fit_markdown), q optional user query, c cache flag. Answers {url, filter, query, cache, markdown, success}. Price: $0.008 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key).

c.description: Cache flag ("0" default, "1" to bypass the cache)

q.description: Optional user query for BM25 fit filtering

url.description: The page to crawl: an https:// URL

name: md
title: Turn a URL into LLM-ready Markdown with crawl4ai's /md contract
